### Loading Data Tables

```{r}
landscape_data <- read.csv("data/raw/garden_landscape.csv")
local_data <- read.csv("data/raw/garden_local.csv")
macro_aps_data <- read.csv("data/raw/macro_aps.csv")
soil_data <- read.csv("data/raw/soil_health.csv")
```

### Loading Relevant Packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

### Cleaning and Merging Data Tables

```{r}
## to edit the misspelling of a few observations in the "class" column in arthropod data sheet
macro_aps_data <- macro_aps_data %>%
  mutate(class = recode(class,
                        "Diplopada" = "Diplopoda"))

## merged soil and arthropod (aps) data 
## soil_data.csv contained the variable "sample_id"
## we needed this variable to merge aps data with landscape data later
soil_aps <- soil_data %>%
  left_join(macro_aps_data, by = "sample_id")

## created new table with variables of interest 
macro_clean <- soil_aps %>%
  select(sample_id,
         site,
         microhabitat,
         class,
         order,
         family,
         emi_score,
         juvenile)

## checked number of unique observations in "class" column
## we pulled the unique aps "class" types to clean data furhter 
unique(macro_aps_data$class)


## counts number of arthrpods in each class
## this removed samples with no observations (no arthropods)
macro_count <- macro_clean %>%
  group_by(sample_id, site, microhabitat) %>%
  filter(class %in% c("Diplopoda", "Insecta", "Malacostraca", "Symphyla", "Chilopoda")) %>%
  count(class)    ## creates new variable "n" with count data

## new arthropod data with total number of arthropods per sample ("n_total")
## and total number of class types per sample ("n_class")
macro_count_2 <- macro_count %>%
  group_by(sample_id) %>%
  summarize(
    n_class = n(),
    total = sum(n)
  )

## final merged table containing soil and arthropod data
soil_aps_clean <- left_join(soil_data, macro_count_2, by = "sample_id")

## landscape_soil_aps - merged data table with landscape and soil_aps data
local_soil_aps <- left_join(soil_aps_clean, local_data, by = "site")

## local_soil_aps - merged data table with local agrden and soil 
landscape_soil_aps <- left_join(soil_aps_clean, landscape_data, by = "site")
  

## final table
soil <- left_join(local_soil_aps, landscape_data, by = "site")
```

### Exploratory Code

```{r}
## avg inorg N values grouped by site and microhabitat (2 observations per garden)
## creates new table without sample_id column
avg_soil <- soil_data %>%
  group_by(site, microhabitat) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_no3 = mean(no3_ug_g, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_nh4 = mean(nh4_ug_g, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_cbh = mean(cbh_mmol_g_h, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_bd = mean(bulk_density, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```
